$comment: Replace repository, checkout, runnerAccount, and targetBranch for your Project. checkout must be absolute. ticketClosure is runner or code_host.

tracker.$comment: GitHub tracker settings. tokenEnv names an environment variable; reservationLabel marks Runner-owned Delivery Tickets.

codeHost.$comment: GitHub Pull Request settings. adminMerge allows or forbids administrative squash merge requests.

workflow.$comment: Both nodes default to true when omitted and can be disabled independently.

agents.$comment: Each Agent Attempt selects a supported model and low, medium, high, or xhigh reasoning. Review and documentation profiles are required only while their workflow nodes are enabled.

ciRepair.$comment: Repair of failed required CI checks.

conflictRepair.$comment: Repair of an explicit merge conflict.

timeouts.$comment: Positive minute limits for Agent Attempts, required-check readiness, and merge-queue confirmation.
